newsitem.title: USA: US CREDIT OUTLOOK -- Focus on June retail sales.
newsitem.headline: US CREDIT OUTLOOK -- Focus on June retail sales.

text.p: The June retail sales report next Tuesday is likely to be the item of most interest to the U.S. credit markets in the coming week, analysts said.
On a calendar crowded with fresh economic news, the retail sales report will be "the main event," said Chris Rupkey, vice president and financial economist at Bank of Tokyo Mitsubishi.
"Retail sales has come to be known as our premier number for estimating how the economy is proceeding," Rupkey said. "So next week the focus will be on that."
